exposure: quality-improvement educational intervention (distribution of educational pocket cards)
outcome: adherence to failed induction of labor (IOL) criteria
cohort: The participants were nulliparous, term, singleton, and vertex (NTSV) cesarean deliveries performed for labor arrest or failed induction of labor.
finding: A quality-improvement educational intervention improved obstetric providers' adherence rates to modern labor arrest and failed induction of labor criteria.
